diff_stats.justification_for_overage: BA spec required ~25 files / 1200-1800 lines. Final 35 files / 3359 lines includes: 24 scenario files (each ~80-150 lines including BDD-style comment headers, fixture authoring, multi-step deploy+rollback chains, and assertion blocks), 7 lib files (averaging 90 lines each), 3 PATH shims, 1 runner. The overage is dominated by (a) BA spec's iter1+iter2+iter3 expansion to 24 scenarios from architect's original 16; (b) S10+S11+S12+S12b+S13+S14+S14b+S15c+S16 each requiring 2-step deploy chains to produce real PRE_TAGs; (c) explanatory comments per BA spec contract C7 and codex iter3 review Q3 (in-line caveats for codex-flagged trade-offs). Each line is functional or directly traceable to a BA spec requirement; no boilerplate.
